admission.mismatch_policy: reject when the content-detected family differs from the extension family
admission.undetected_policy: reject except CSV after bounded text validation
admission.scanner_order: malware scan before format parsing or durable persistence

pdf.mixed_or_image_only_pages: reject the complete input as needs_ocr when any page yields no text
pdf.warning: PDF images, layout, and source-position image links are not preserved

asset_free.condition: no embedded-asset or unavailable-image source position exists

all_assets_unavailable.condition: one or more unavailable-image source positions exist and no exportable embedded asset exists
all_assets_unavailable.unavailable_asset_count: number of unavailable image-inline occurrences in source-position traversal order

assets.selection: only embedded image assets referenced by an image inline in the shared Document model
assets.duplicates: the same asset id reuses one filename; byte-identical different ids deduplicate to the first-reference filename
assets.normalization: reuse the T08 signature-checked, single-frame, bounded deterministic PNG normalization and network-disabled SVG rasterization boundary
assets.external: reject document-controlled external image sources; never fetch them
assets.unavailable: retain escaped alt text without an image link; emit a ZIP whenever at least one unavailable image-inline occurrence exists, including when every asset is unavailable
